استسمحن (form X)
# اِسْتَسْمَحْنَ (istasmaḥna) /is.tas.maħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَسْمَحَ (istasmaḥa)
# اُسْتُسْمِحْنَ (ustusmiḥna) /us.tus.miħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَسْمَحَ (istasmaḥa)
# اِسْتَسْمِحْنَ (istasmiḥna) /is.tas.miħ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَسْمَحَ (istasmaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
